This part-time position's hours are 15-20 hours per week, depending on the competitive season. Must be available for extensive weekend and evening hours during the season. Travel may be required. Must be willing to work a flexible schedule.

items.item_text: A valid driver’s license is required or an equivalent means of reliable transportation to off-site meetings and events.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience required; previous playing or coaching experience is required . Capacity to positively interact with and support a culturally, ethnically, economically, and socially diverse population of students, faculty, and staff.
A minimum of 2 years of experience as a coach at the collegiate or professional level of athletic
Responsibilities include assisting the head coaches with the organization and implementation of practice plans and instruction for Shot Put, Discus, Hammer, and Javelin;
Developing competition-day strategies and tactical planning; assessing and recruiting potential student-athletes;
Evaluating competition sites and creating scouting reports;
Assisting with home meet hosting duties, camps, and clinic operations;
Overseeing team equipment; and assisting with the management of social media accounts.
